metadata.name: time
metadata.displayName: time - Run programs and report resource usage
metadata.description: Run a command and report time and resource usage

installation.note: time can be a shell built-in (bash) or /usr/bin/time (GNU time); built-in shows simple elapsed time, GNU time shows more details

overview.summary: time runs a command and reports how long it took. The shell built-in (time command) shows user/sys/real time in a simple form; the GNU time binary (/usr/bin/time) can show memory, I/O, and other resource usage.
when_to_use: Measure how long a command takes

syntax.description: Run COMMAND and print timing (and optionally resource) summary when it finishes.

options.description: Show detailed resource usage (memory, I/O, etc.)
options.use_case: See memory and I/O stats (use full path for GNU time)

examples.title: Time a command
examples.description: Run ls and show real/user/sys time

examples.title: Detailed resource usage
examples.description: Run program and show memory, I/O, etc.

related_commands.description: Print current time; sometimes used with time for scripting
